# Suites

4 suite(s). Regenerate with `python3 scripts/gen_suites.py`.

A suite is a named list of selectors stood up in one run; the format is [schemas/suite-format.md](schemas/suite-format.md). Reference one from the CLI with the explicit `suite:` prefix:

```bash
vulnsuite run -t suite:<name>              # the suite's default set
vulnsuite run -t suite:<name> -variants    # expand every group member
```

Per suite below: **Default** is the set a bare `suite:<name>` stands up; a group handle contributes its primary (★) by default and the rest (`-variants` only) are listed too. Suites carry no CVE facts — they reference targets by selector only.
